title: Curfew Library Roster Batch
description: Additive-only forever from Story 4.11 onward, same AD-15 discipline as sync-payload.schema.json and sync-library-add-events.schema.json. The THIRD sanctioned agent write (AD-22, after AD-20's status heartbeat and AD-21's library add-event batch) -- a current-state, mutable record of the tracks the DJ owns (Tier A: title/artist only; BPM/key/genre are Tier B, out of scope). Deliberately separate from SyncLibraryAddEventBatch: that batch is go-forward-only and first-write-wins (baseline tracks never appear in it), while this roster is current-state (title/artist refresh on a re-tag) and DOES carry baseline tracks -- the two tables this batch and that one write to serve different purposes and must never be conflated. Language-neutral mirror of SyncLibraryRosterBatch in @curfew/shared.

contract_version.description: Contract version this batch was produced against.

agent_version.description: Semver of the producing agent -- same traceability role as SyncPayload.agent_version.

track_id.description: Opaque fnv1a_hex track identity (Story 4.3, Decision E-2) -- the same value SyncPlay.track_id/SyncLibraryAddEvent.track_id carry.

title.description: Raw, un-normalized song title. null only in the pathological case where a fixed test catalogue never populated it -- a track missing EITHER a resolvable title or a resolvable artist has no track_id to report under at all -- the identity hash requires both (AD-11).

artist.description: Raw, un-normalized artist. Same absence rule as title.

added_at.description: Unix epoch SECONDS -- when the library first saw this track, from database V2's tadd/uadd. null when no reachable catalogue covers the track -- never guessed (AD-11). Fixed at first sighting; never updated by a later batch for the same track_id. Epoch integers, not ISO 8601: the RPC parses these with to_timestamp(...::bigint), matching sync_set/sync_library_add_events. See ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md's Dates/times convention row.

is_baseline.description: true for D-1's silent first-run baseline snapshot. Fixed at first sighting -- must never be read for conversion-rate cohort math (that denominator is library_track_events/AD-21, a wholly separate table).

absent_at.description: Unix epoch SECONDS, or null if the track is currently present in the DJ's library. Set when a previously-known track goes missing from a scan (Story 4.11 AC-5), cleared if it reappears. A soft-delete marker, never a hard removal.
